title: Uninstall cannot remove machine-wide light hooks yet
text: Machine uninstall reverts every harness setting recorded in the machine home's harness-settings-written.json, strips Yoke's Cursor user hooks and removes the yoke-global skill folder and Claude link, which install records as created_dir entries. The machine-wide light hooks do not exist yet; when they land they must record their writes in that file so uninstall removes them.
